name: Disk-Monitor
description: See the health, temperature, sleep state and activity of every disk in your MOS box.

paths.name: Cache
paths.description: Disk Monitor's saved data: SMART history, settings, email settings, the login password file (password.txt) and the session secret (.session_secret). Back this folder up.

paths.name: Sys
paths.description: The host's /sys, read-only, so the app can see your disks.

paths.name: Proc
paths.description: The host's /proc, read-only, for mount points and disk activity.

paths.name: Dev
paths.description: The host's devices, for reading SMART data and sending standby commands.

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Your time zone, like Europe/London or America/New_York.

variables.name: DISK_MONITOR_USERNAME
variables.description: The username for the Disk Monitor login screen. admin is fine, or pick your own.

variables.name: DISK_MONITOR_PASSWORD
variables.description: The password for the Disk Monitor login screen. Leave it blank and the app makes a random one on first start. Find it in /mnt/cache/appdata/disk-monitor/cache/password.txt (open it with the Files app) or in the app log. Or type your own here: at least 12 characters, or the app won't start.
